charts.title: K2-26 b: orbits around K2-26
charts.description: The orbits of K2-26's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-26 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Beichman et al. 2016 (2016ApJ...822...39B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BEICHMAN_ET_AL__2016): P 14.568101 d

charts.title: K2-26 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-26 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 83181153, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 19-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 19-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
